authority.source_authority: DAD governs its registries and adaptation; the live global skill root, Logos, Mock Trial, and external sources retain their own authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-writer may edit the DAD worktree and approved live global skill; scouts and independent-checker remain read-only.

roles.why_needed: Existing DAD, Logos, Mock Trial, and global capabilities must be reused instead of duplicated.
roles.mission: Return bounded metadata and code pointers, stable identities, overlap, gaps, and source-authority cautions.
inputs: approved sibling repository metadata and code paths
roles.authority: Read-only; may not copy private content or edit any repository.
acceptance_conditions: Exact reusable identities and actionable gaps are reported.
stop_conditions: Private or client content would be required.

readiness_conditions: Paths and source-authority boundaries are explicit.

roles.why_needed: The field changes quickly and the initial library needs current primary-source evidence.
roles.mission: Synthesize primary standards, official documentation, original papers, counterevidence, uncertainties, and a watchlist.
roles.authority: Read-only research; pointers and bounded claims only; no promotion or scheduling authority.
acceptance_conditions: Dated sources, technique taxonomy, evaluation gates, and uncertainties are reported.
stop_conditions: A claim lacks a primary source or source terms are unclear.

readiness_conditions: Claims are separable from vendor conclusions.

roles.why_needed: One writer must integrate the portable skill, schemas, registries, code, and tests without overlapping edits.
roles.mission: Implement the accepted phased plan and produce deterministic validation evidence.
roles.authority: May edit only this DAD worktree and the explicitly requested knowledge-engineering-ops live global skill and allowlist row.
acceptance_conditions: All local phases pass focused validation and no prohibited external effect occurs.
stop_conditions: Scope, privacy, source authority, recurring activation, or cross-repository write changes.

readiness_conditions: Focused checks pass and limitations are explicit.

roles.why_needed: The writer cannot approve a load-bearing portable family and shared registry change.
roles.mission: Re-derive acceptance and red-team correctness, overlap, portability, privacy, authority, routing, graph, schedule, and regression evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot edit or approve its own work.
acceptance_conditions: Release gate, failed and unknown checks, counterevidence, and disagreements are explicit.
stop_conditions: Checker independence or replayable evidence is unavailable.

readiness_conditions: Writer evidence and raw diff are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove the capability is a child specialist pack and reuses existing research, graph, quality, privacy, and routing authority.
Prove durable roles and technique contracts contain no permanent vendor model identity or local absolute path.
Prove catalog, routing, graph, and weekly research surfaces are candidate-only and cannot schedule, promote, ingest, index, or mutate.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Exact weekly activation time, delivery surface, source budget, and persistent schedule require a later A3 human decision.

reconciliations.reason: The scout completed the planned bounded inventory without scope drift.
The scout completed the planned primary-source synthesis without scope drift.
The accepted implementation scope and authority remain unchanged.
The planned fresh read-only independent gate remains required.
